create_AppendTokenDataset: create an AppendTokenDataset that appends a specified token to each item in a wrapped dataset
use_AppendTokenDataset_getitem: use AppendTokenDataset getitem to retrieve a dataset item with an appended token at a given index
check_AppendTokenDataset_sizes: check the sizes property of AppendTokenDataset to get sequence lengths incremented by one per item
call_AppendTokenDataset_num_tokens: call num_tokens on AppendTokenDataset to get the token count for a sample including the appended token
call_AppendTokenDataset_size: call size on AppendTokenDataset to get the size of a sample including the appended token
